title: LFGSwap EthereumPoW — zombie-hunt II Phase-2 deep dive (UniV2 fork on ETHW)
headline_note: Risk-free extraction by an external unprivileged attacker is $0. Conditional one-shot face-value play of ~$144 exists only if the chain-local USDT/USDC/BUSD redeem at ~par; at realizable on-chain prices those trades lose $3.9 / $53.6.
closed_reasons: canonical UniV2 pair logic with k-invariant enforced (source + fork test)
factory admin (feeTo/feeToSetter) controlled by a 3/5 Gnosis-Safe-style multisig proxy; setters revert for outsiders
LFG token mint permanently disabled (0 minters, owner renounced)
chain-local USDT/USDC/BUSD mint controller-gated (EOA, not accessible)
no public mint on meme counter-tokens (Pepe/FROG/wFire/SHIBW/DX)
no profitable closed arbitrage loop in hard assets (all 2-3 hop cycles optimized on fresh reserves)
the only externally valuable asset is ETHW/WETHW; all value-draining routes require paying more value than they return
key_facts: deployed pair = UniV2Pair + permit + initialize; source repo LfgSwap/lfg-protocol matches (k-check 'LfgSwap: K' present); zero-reserve pairs are bricked (swap reverts)
fork-verified: k-violating 90% drain reverts; initialize() reverts; setFeeTo/setFeeToSetter revert for arbitrary callers
Fork PoC: WETHW->Pepe->USDT: 20 WETHW -> 22,314,463,830,623,868 Pepe -> 18.191224 USDT (face)
Fork PoC: closing the loop WETHW->Pepe->USDT->USDC->WETHW returns only 5.836076960596908643 WETHW for 20 WETHW in (loss 14.16 WETHW = -$3.86)
Fork PoC USDC soak: 226.4 WETHW ($61.7) -> 15.00253 USDC -> 193.042079 USDT (face) - only profitable if USDT/C redeem at par
USDT realizable exit on-chain: 18.19 USDT -> 5.836 WETHW ($1.59) = ~$0.0875/USDT => face-value arbitrage is a loss at realizable prices
chain-local stables have active issuer EOAs (owner nonce 47, controller nonce 11203) - redeemability externally unverifiable
Triage/USD face values ($120.1k balance-read / $295.7k DefiLlama) are dominated by vvXEN ($113k at $4.898e-9), a XEN-fork whose only venues are these pools
caveats: USDT/USDC/BUSD redeemability is the single largest uncertainty; DefiLlama prices them ~$1.00 (conf 0.99) but the only on-chain exit prices USDT at $0.06-0.32
vvXEN price ($4.898e-9) drives 94% of triage USD; token has no external venue inside the audited system
meme counter-tokens are owner-controlled launch tokens (fees/limits settable); fork tests measured current settings
no indexer available for a full holder scan of possible hidden farms; source repo, minter lists and router show no farm on ETHW
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 risk-free from LFGSwap on ETHW: pair/admin/mint surfaces are closed and every value-draining route costs more than it returns; the $120-296k face TVL is locked behind illiquid/XEN-fork tokens - with a conditional ~$144 one-shot upside only if the chain-local stablecoins redeem at par.
